name: io.demarker/mcp
title: Demarker
description: Identify what an AI image carries (marks, metadata, watermarks), then clean it.

environmentVariables.name: DEMARKER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Needed to clean images and read balance. Create one at https://demarker.io/app/settings/api

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Hard ceiling on credits one clean call may spend. Default 2.
